en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large manor complex. On the right is a long, two‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and many shuttered windows, largely covered in ivy. To the left stands a tall, narrow tower with a balcony below its spire. In the background is an arched gateway and additional estate buildings. Printed red text at the top names the estate, and more text is printed vertically along the left edge.
